tasks.title: Fix 7 anti-pattern .fetch(new Request(...)) calls
tasks.description: Replace all instances of agent.fetch(new Request('http://...')) with proper @callable() RPC calls. Per Cloudflare Agents SDK: never construct HTTP requests to talk to a Durable Object.
requirements: Fix routes/api/ux/index.ts:79 — agent.fetch(new Request('http://agent/stream')) against DESIGN_AGENT → use @callable() or WebSocket for streaming
Fix routes/api/webhooks/jules.ts:96 — agent.fetch(new Request('http://internal/internal/broadcast')) against JULES_WEBHOOK_BROADCASTER → agent.broadcast(payload)
Fix routes/api/webhooks/jules.ts:191 — agent.fetch(new Request('http://jules-overseer/schedule/check')) against JULES_OVERSEER → ENGINEER_AGENT agent.checkSchedule()
Fix routes/api/ops/health.ts:69 — agent.fetch(new Request('http://agent/diagnose')) against LEARNING_AGENT → agent.diagnose(errorInfo)
Fix routes/api/projects/sentinel/broadcast.ts:24 — agent.fetch(new Request('http://internal/internal/broadcast')) → agent.broadcast(payload)
Fix routes/api/projects/sentinel/clarify.ts:32 — agent.fetch(new Request('http://internal/internal/broadcast')) → agent.broadcast(payload)
Fix routes/api/projects/sentinel/submit.ts:84-85 — c.env.JUDGE_AGENT.fetch(new Request('http://judge/task')) → GUARDRAIL_AGENT agent.judgeCodeQuality(...)
For DesignAgent streaming: if @callable() cannot return a streaming response, keep onRequest for /stream but route via routeAgentRequest() — document the exception with a comment
success_criteria: grep -r 'new Request.*http://agent\|new Request.*http://internal\|new Request.*http://judge\|new Request.*http://jules-overseer' src/backend/src/routes returns zero matches
